id: title:frankh:gate promql logql proxy endpoints behind a shared feature flag

review.abstention_reason: The provided observations explicitly state that the chunk does not include the implementation of the permission class, the complete SnuffleProxyViewSet, or the removal of the old gated behavior. Without the actual permission check implementation and the complete removal of the Prometheus gate, it is impossible to establish a tier. The tier cannot be established.
review.posthog_relevance: Unable to establish; the relevant implementation and removal of gating are missing.
review.reason: The chunk lacks the implementation of PostHogFeatureFlagPermission and the complete removal of the Prometheus query gating. The observations describe the *intent* and *behavior* of the change, but not the *code* that realizes it. Therefore, no tier can be assigned.
review.uncertainty: The tier is unestablished because the critical implementation details and removal of the previous gate are absent from the provided chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition or implementation of PostHogFeatureFlagPermission, nor the complete SnuffleProxyViewSet class, nor the removal of the old METRICS_FEATURE_FLAG. It also does not show the actual permission check implementation or the complete removal of the old gated behavior. Without these, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a new permission class and feature flag to SnuffleProxyViewSet, while removing the same permission and a different feature flag from PrometheusQueryViewSet.
observations.posthog_connection: Gates access to the Snuffle proxy API and Prometheus query API using a shared permission and a specific feature flag, while removing the previous gate from Prometheus. This could allow shared enforcement of private-alpha access and remove redundant gating from Prometheus, but the actual permission implementation and the reason for removing the Prometheus gate are not shown.
